title: Correlate memory records with local receipts
summary: Add an explicit memory-record correlation field to local settlement receipts so verifiers and operators can join memory writes to receipts without relying on ordering or audit inference.
expectedFailureModes: Memory and receipt drift reports cannot identify which receipt belongs to which memory record.
Adding receipt metadata breaks backward-compatible receipt reads.
Docs claim exact reconciliation while the receipt schema still lacks a memory id.
nextAction: Design and implement a backward-compatible receipt correlation field for memory writes, then update verifier/docs.
